bio.text: Joseph Cinquemani is the Republican candidate for New York's 16th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democratic incumbent George Latimer.

Ballotpedia lists Cinquemani as a lawyer who graduated from Pearl River High School, earned a bachelor's degree from Cornell University's School of Industrial and Labor Relations in 1990 and a law degree from Fordham University School of Law in 1994.
